entries.label: Iran
entries.summary: Iran's nuclear standoff and regional influence make it the top risk.
entries.quote: This year could be the most politically unstable year in the middle east in the past two decades, and Iran is at the center of this instability.

entries.label: Nigeria

entries.label: Russia

notes: The 2007 list has seven risks ('Top 7 Political Risks for 2007'), outlined by Ian Bremmer on 2 January 2007. Quotes for the seven risks are from the archived publications page summaries.
